info.title: Azure Migrate Projects Service
info.description: Azure Migrate Resource Provider management API for Migrate projects and their child resources.

get.description: Get the status of an asynchronous generateDownloadUrl operation. When the operation succeeds, the generated download URL is available in the `properties` field of the returned status monitor.
List the artifacts of a Migrate project, optionally filtered by associated resource ID or artifact type.
Get the specified artifact by name.

post.description: Generate a time-limited download URL for the content of an artifact. For a single file the download URL is returned synchronously (200). For a directory the request is accepted (202) and runs asynchronously; poll the operation through the Azure-AsyncOperation status monitor, whose terminal status carries the generated download URL in its `properties`.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: The content of the action request

Azure-AsyncOperation.description: A link to the status monitor

Retry-After.description: The Retry-After header can indicate how long the client should wait before polling the operation status.

post.description: Get the version history of an artifact. The service retains only the 20 most recent versions, so the returned history contains at most 20 entries.

parameters.name: planName
parameters.description: The name of the Migrate plan.

put.description: Register or activate a Migrate plan. Registering creates the plan; supplying artifacts activates it and starts plan generation. This is a synchronous (non-LRO) operation: provisioningState is terminal in the response, and asynchronous plan-generation progress is tracked by polling the read-only `status` property via GET until it reaches a terminal value.

parameters.name: planName
parameters.description: The name of the Migrate plan.

patch.description: Update a Migrate plan. Supports updating the migration strategy. Artifact `status` is read-only and reflects server-computed plan-generation progress, so it cannot be changed through this operation.

GenerateDownloadUrlRequest.description: The request to generate a download URL for a Migrate artifact. Clients need not specify both of `versionId` and `version`. If both are specified, they must agree with each other. If neither is specified, the latest version is used.

versionId.description: The identifier of the artifact version to download. When omitted, the latest version of the artifact is used. If both `versionId` and `version` are specified, they must agree with each other.

version.description: The version number to download. When omitted, the latest artifact version is used. If both `versionId` and `version` are specified, they must agree with each other.

mode.description: Whether to download a single file or a directory within the artifact.

path.description: The path within the artifact version. In single-file mode, a non-empty path is required. In directory mode, an empty string or `/` selects the whole artifact version; otherwise, the value is treated as a directory prefix.

includeMetadata.description: Whether to include metadata alongside the downloaded content.

GenerateDownloadUrlResult.description: The result of generating a download URL for a Migrate artifact.

versionId.description: The identifier of the artifact version that the download URL refers to.

version.description: The version number of the artifact version present at the download URL.

mode.description: Whether the download URL refers to a single file or a directory within the artifact.

path.description: The path, relative to the artifact root, that the download URL refers to.

sasUrl.description: The shared access signature (SAS) URL that can be used to download the requested content.

expiresAt.description: The timestamp, in UTC, at which the download URL expires.
